info.submission:
Fixed two issues in cell 3:

1. Removed `base_model.load_weights('data/vgg_face_weights.h5')` - this line was causing a ValueError because the standard VGG16 model (13 layers) was incompatible with the VGGFace weights file (16 layers). The architectures don't match, so the weights cannot be loaded.

2. Added classification layers to the VGG16 base model - since `include_top=False`, the model output was a 4D feature map `(None, 7, 7, 512)` which was incompatible with categorical cross-entropy loss expecting 2D class predictions `(None, 7)`. Added Flatten layer, a Dense(512) layer, and a final Dense(7) with softmax to produce proper class predictions for the 7 classes.

The model now trains successfully using ImageNet pre-trained weights as a feature extractor with trainable classification layers on top.

main_data_directory = 'data/train-data-imgs'

    width_shift_range=0.2,

    target_size=input_size,

    shuffle=True
)

base_model.fit(

    steps_per_epoch=len(train_generator),
    epochs=10,
)
